title: Getting a translator ready for a trip
description: The languages and modes you need are tested without a connection before you leave.

blocks.text: A downloaded pack does not necessarily include voice and camera. On the spot it is too late to find out which step needs a connection.

quote.text: Takes forever to find a translation. Even if I download the languages I need it still tries to find using the internet which can  be extremely slow when traveling internationally. Now I have to put my iphone into airplane mode to get an instant offline translation which is annoying.

blocks.text: Show what the pack can do item by item and run a trial of text, speech and a photo with the network switched off. Keep a result of that check that can be understood.
Do not pass a successful text translation off as every mode being ready. An update or a change of language calls for testing the scenario you need again.
